name: io.github.shenn667/agent-context-bridge
title: Agent Context Bridge
description: Zero-dependency offline shared context & memory bridge for coding agents (Hermes, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex). MCP server exposes 2 strictly read-only tools: acb_search (full-text search over past decisions, constraints, task notes) and acb_status (store health: records, size, agent coverage). Recording, pruning, and auditing stay CLI-only, so the server can never modify state.
